displayDescription: A graphite hub rises in a dark studio, threads draw to three nodes that light up, then the lockup settles.
styleRenderer: Three.js 0.186 WebGL (MeshPhysicalMaterial, LatheGeometry, TubeGeometry, RoomEnvironment PMREM), bundled locally to scene.js
motionEngine: GSAP paused timeline registered inline in index.html at window.__timelines.video, driving a time proxy for the Three.js renderer and the SVG overlay
limitations: Blender was excluded on user instruction; the product is real-time Three.js geometry with an ACES tone-mapped PBR approximation, not a path-traced render.
Lighting uses a procedural RoomEnvironment and directional rim lights; there are no contact shadows or ray-traced reflections.
No preview recipe was supplied in STYLE.json, so this preview covers the base style and the scene-dependent background refresh.
The background palette was chosen for this scene from the source-frame lessons (low-key field, product as the luminance peak, one accent). It is not an approved brand palette.
